data.message: I individually opt in to 18 tons; this is not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, stock left=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). All18 leaves50, then500 or100: recovery is risky, not guaranteed optimal long-run. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation. Fellow recruiters, help seek individual choices.
